children: Natural Alternatives International's net sales fell 25% and its net loss widened year over year, as private-label contract manufacturing sales declined 29% amid lower orders from major and other existing customers; patent and trademark licensing sales rose 54%, primarily on higher TriBsyn® sales.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Sales decreased 29%, primarily on lower orders from one of the largest customers and several other existing customers.
: Revenue increased 54% to $2.6M, primarily on higher TriBsyn® product sales, partly offset by lower CarnoSyn® raw material sales.
: Contract manufacturing gross profit margin fell 10.7 percentage points as lower sales volume reduced factory capacity utilization.
: The company anticipates higher net sales in fiscal 2027 than fiscal 2026 and a return to profitability in fiscal 2027's fourth quarter.
: Production is being consolidated into the Vista facility, with no disruption to customer products, to reduce excess capacity and improve efficiency.
